title: Vegetarian Appleton Monsoon Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry made with the bold flavors of appleton and monsoon. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy vegetarian meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of appleton in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell peppers and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown.
Add the monsoon and stir to combine.
Serve the tofu and vegetable mixture over cooked brown rice.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
